inputs.text: Terry Pheto has again been drawn into controversy after new details presented in Parliament linked her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission. The revelations came during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The report describes it as an alleged R20.56 million NLC funding scandal under investigation by the SIU.
